method: Each round length with work::ROUND_BUDGET set to it before building round_sweep (release), run with --round-budget-ms equal to it, so every per-call time derived from the round follows too: what ROUND_SWEEP_BUDGETS_MS=<ms> cargo xtask stress rounds runs. Each round length ran on its own CPU, all at once.

scenario.description: Round length against catch-up throughput, refetched blocks and the wait between rounds (docs/engine_stress.md, round length sweep). v2 adds a high-latency (Tor-like) node, and the node answers the tip with its id and the pool in one request, as the real client does.
